description: This file contains Polymer framework features, including template preparation, host registration, content distribution, and DOM API extensions, primarily for custom element and shadow DOM management.

methods.name: _prepTemplate
methods.description: Prepares the template by importing and decorating it, ensuring it is not a type extension.

methods.name: _stampTemplate
methods.description: Instances the template content into the DOM.

methods.name: instanceTemplate
methods.description: Creates a clone of the template content.

methods.name: _addFeature
methods.description: Adds framework features such as host registration, content distribution, and DOM API extensions.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Flushes pending DOM operations and debouncers.

methods.name: addStaticFlush
methods.description: Registers a static flush function to be called during flush.

methods.name: removeStaticFlush
methods.description: Removes a previously registered static flush function.

methods.name: addDebouncer
methods.description: Adds a debouncer to batch DOM updates.

methods.name: _flush
methods.description: Performs the flush operation, executing debouncers and static functions.
